bug_semantics: An authenticated backend user holding backend.manage_editor can store attacker-controlled LESS in Editor Settings -> Markup Styles (html_custom_styles). LESS escaped-string syntax can preserve a literal </style><script>...</script><style> sequence. The compiled value is cached and emitted inside the backend-wide <style> block, so an unsanitized cache miss or cache hit permits stored XSS when another backend user loads a page.
flaw_origin: Commit c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87 reintroduced the flaw by replacing <?= strip_tags(EditorSetting::renderCss()) ?> with <?= EditorSetting::renderCss() ?> in modules/backend/layouts/_custom_styles.php while leaving successful Less_Parser output raw and cached. Its immediate parent retained the only sanitizer at the render sink. The commit directly changed the vulnerable sink; it is not merely an import, move, release aggregate, or squash.
ai_marker: absent: `git cat-file commit c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87` shows a single parent, human author and committer Luke Towers <git@luketowers.ca>, and only the message `Improve escaping of error messages when compiling custom CSS for Brand & Editor settings`; there is no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI marker in the BIC commit object.
evidence: The bundle's first-party advisory snapshot names d28f0b9474af79cfaa80eeb9d691f7a7c4469720, claims >=1.2.10,<1.2.13 with 1.2.13 first patched, and describes attacker-controlled editor styles compiled by LESS and rendered on every backend page. BIC checks: `git cat-file commit c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87` gives parent 22df8f1d6d8e95487e385bd4f052d0c772a2b3fc and marker-free human metadata; `git diff 22df8f1d6d8e95487e385bd4f052d0c772a2b3fc c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87 -- modules/backend/layouts/_custom_styles.php modules/backend/models/EditorSetting.php` shows the direct strip_tags deletion, while `git grep -n 'EditorSetting::renderCss' 22df8f1d6d8e95487e385bd4f052d0c772a2b3fc -- modules/backend` finds only the guarded parent call. `git tag --contains c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87 --sort=version:refname` starts at v1.2.10. Fix checks resolve the primary/reviewer dispute: `git show d28f0b9474af79cfaa80eeb9d691f7a7c4469720 -- modules/backend/models/EditorSetting.php` adds strip_tags only to the cache-miss return. `git blame -L 244,262 v1.2.13 -- modules/backend/models/EditorSetting.php` still shows `return Cache::get($cacheKey)` on the earlier cache-hit branch, after a cache miss stores raw compiler output. `git grep -n 'return.*Cache::get' a56ef40be9e6c8a050b96895abce9fe9c22a1782 -- modules/backend/models/EditorSetting.php` confirms c95d780ab54f3a3f74a94ae1667bf12b3c549d5d's immediate parent is still vulnerable; the same grep at c95d780ab54f3a3f74a94ae1667bf12b3c549d5d shows `return strip_tags(Cache::get($cacheKey))`. Its patch also adds cache-hit and pre-existing-cache regression coverage, so it is a direct source fix rather than an aggregate, import, or move. `git tag --contains d28f0b9474af79cfaa80eeb9d691f7a7c4469720 --sort=version:refname` starts at v1.2.13, whereas the same command for c95d780ab54f3a3f74a94ae1667bf12b3c549d5d starts at v1.2.14; `git blame -L 244,262 v1.2.14 -- modules/backend/models/EditorSetting.php` attributes the sanitized cache-hit return to c95d780ab54f3a3f74a94ae1667bf12b3c549d5d.
reasoning: The primary treated advisory-linked d28f0b9474af79cfaa80eeb9d691f7a7c4469720 as both fix_sha and the complete direct fix. The reviewer retained it as the advisory-named fix_sha but identified c95d780ab54f3a3f74a94ae1667bf12b3c549d5d as direct_fix_sha. The rerun supports the reviewer: d28 sanitizes only a cache miss, while v1.2.13 immediately returns poisoned raw cached CSS on a hit; c95 directly sanitizes that surviving path, its parent is vulnerable, and it first appears in v1.2.14. Thus d28 remains the advisory-linked partial fix, c95 is the smallest complete direct fix, and the true complete-fix release boundary is v1.2.14 rather than the advisory's claimed v1.2.13. The agreed BIC is also independently gate-complete: its immediate parent has the guard, the BIC directly deletes it, release ancestry starts at v1.2.10, and its own commit object contains no AI signal, yielding NOT_AI.
